Demonstrated experience in quality improvement to improve patient outcomes.
Experienced in providing and/or oversight of care.

We are recruiting a full-time, board-certified/board-eligible physician in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PM&R) with specialized training in Pain Medicine. Fellowship training in Pain Medicine is required. Primary responsibilities include providing comprehensive evaluation and management of acute and chronic pain conditions, performing appropriate interventional pain procedures, and developing an outpatient pain medicine practice at UCI Health community clinical sites. The ideal candidate will be motivated to grow a practice and foster collaborative relationships with primary care physicians, specialists, rehabilitation providers, and other clinicians across the UCI Health system.

This opportunity will be a part of the expanding Specialty Care Associates (SCA) community network at UCI, working alongside other physicians and surgeons in the SCA network. UCI is a leader in patient quality and safety outcomes.
Your Role on the Team
Provide excellent clinical care.
Provide outpatient PM&R and pain medicine consultations and follow-up care at UCI Health community sites.
Develop and expand a multidisciplinary pain medicine practice, including appropriate image-guided interventional pain procedures within the physician’s training and clinical privileges.
Communicate and collaborate with faculty, colleagues, residents, fellows, staff, and peers to maintain a professional, team-based approach to patient care.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and objectives and comply with all UC policies and procedures.
Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all state and federal privacy laws.
Successful completion of an accredited PM&R residency and Pain Medicine fellowship.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and objectives while in compliance of all UC policies and procedures. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all state and federal privacy laws.
Leadership skills; ability to motivate, inspire, communicate with faculty, residents, staff, and peers to maintain a professional, team-based approach in the care of patients.
